_doc: cockpit settings. Your own JSON (userConfig 'config', else ~/.claude/effort-board/cockpit.config.json) is deep-merged over this file; keys starting with _ are ignored. Prices, thresholds and screen labels of the detail views are factory's (lib/factory/factory.config.json + ~/.claude/effort-board/factory.config.json).
_panel: The Panneau, the DEFAULT view (Julian, 17 Oct): ONE scrolling column, no tab bar; the old views are reached by their /cockpit command only, listed in one grey line at the bottom. Drawn like Claude's own Usage and Background-tasks panes (Julian, 17 Oct 18:10): cards with a bold title, rows « label … grey detail bold value » over a thin full-width bar (Svg on the desktop, ▰▱ text elsewhere), small stats grids, phases with ■□ dots, no box-drawing borders; the left text is cut, never the numbers. Top to bottom: fichiers (data-goblin's file tree, embedded, FOLDED by default: a folder opens on a click, a clicked file is named to Claude with the next prompt exactly as filetree does, attach_selection false = visual only; max_rows then « Plus de lignes » by more_step; git letters), conv (a Usage-like card for the lead: title, model · effort · state, the context row and bar with the hand-off mark at contexte.handoff_tokens, a stats grid cost / tokens / cache hit / % sous-agents / agents / tok/s, the model share, « Ce qui contribue »; then one Background-tasks-like card per Workflow, folded by default as Claude's mini card (« name › », « Workflow  N agents  6h 56m », one dot per agent: grey ■ done, amber ■ running, □ pending; style.workflow_open, style.dot_tones), unfolded to « tokens  $ » and Phases with ■□ dots, each phase unfolding to Claude's « Modèle | Temps » table (« ✓ Opus 5.5 … 1h 07m 29s », amber ● running) with a grey line of extras under each agent (label, effort, tokens, tok/s), and one for the background agents; finished cards folded into « Terminés N › » (style.finished_open); the session log of the last log_max events; agents_max per phase, contributors rows), convs (every conversation from the usage mod's classement.json, one line each: state mark, title, tokens, the thin bar of Barres (Svg on the desktop) and its share; one filter row of cycling buttons période ▾ / Projet ▾ / État ▾ / Claude ▾; top N + autres; basis tokens|cost; then Workflows actifs of the PC, each unfolding to its agents), barres (Session 5 h and Semaine with their reset, Codex semaine while Codex is toggled, Crédits cloud when the engine reads them (« 249 $ sur 250 $ » and « expire le … » when it gives the amounts, else the % with « montant non lu »), tok/s of all conversations), debit (tokens per second per model, see _debit), graphe (Graphe des conversations: À toi de cliquer = sessions waiting for Julian, oldest first, the only place with their detail; one short legend line of the state marks, folded behind « Légende › » when narrow; one filter row « 24 h ▾ » « Projet ▾ » Actives Archivées; one group per project like the sidebar, starred first, a small grey header only for groups of 2+, spawned children indented under their parent; each conversation ONE line: state mark, title (opens the conversation), grey project name for a group of one and « coord » for a coordinator, tokens today · ctx % and a tiny context bar on the right; a second grey line only for « lancée par / ⇢ message »; travaille = latest of lastActivityAt and transcript mtime under working_min, or a running Workflow / background agent; finie only after done_min idle minutes with nothing running; lib/graphe.mjs + hooks/graphe_view.mjs, settings under panel.graphe). Each conversation row of convs and of the graph unfolds UNDER itself to that conversation's own factory, drawn as « Cette conversation » (model · effort · state, context bar, stats, its Workflow cards with phases and agent dots, background agents, Terminés N ›), one step in behind a thin grey « │ » rule, Workflows one step further, agents one more (the engine draws a Box border on all four sides only); its title or › / ⌄ unfolds it, a small « ouvrir ↗ » at the right opens it in the app (« ↗ » under style.wide_cols). Since 20 Oct a row's › unfolds only its children (sub-conversations, running Workflows / agents, Terminés N ›; unfolded by default while one runs, at most convs.tree_max) and its card is behind « détails › » on its metrics line, folded by default; a graph row unfolds its card, at most convs.unfold_max (0) by itself (the engine draws the first 100,000 characters of a pane's texts; the pane scrolls with no line limit); finie, inactive and archived start folded; the viewer's folds win and are kept (key cv:<cli>, shared by both lists). An empty line and a thin grey rule separate the sections and the unfolded conversations; section titles are bold, heading size. Every section folds; what the viewer opens, folds and filters is kept in $.store (v2: only what the viewer toggled). enabled false: back to the Cockpit tab by default. style: bar_px (px per column of an Svg bar), bar_cells / bar_cells_wide / wide_cols (the short bars of a compact row), finished_open, the dot and bar characters. State marks and colours in panel.marks (● travaille green ok, ◆ attend amber warn, ✕ bloquée red bad, ✓ finie and ○ inactive grey dim: theme tones), the same in convs, the graph and its legend. Every label under panel.labels (lib/panel.mjs PANEL_DEFAULTS has them all).

panel._tree: The tree of CETTE CONVERSATION and CONVERSATIONS (Julian, 20 Oct: « ajoute de l'indentation »): indent = columns per level, the connector « ├──── » and the « │ » rule under it (a number, at least 2), or "auto": 6 at style.wide_cols (60) columns and more, 4 under it. The metrics line starts under the title's first letter; a « │ » line separates sibling conversations, none between the agents of one Workflow.
panel._debit: Débit (Julian, 18 Oct, after Codex's « tokens per second » table): one card per model in use (Codex models only while the Codex toggle of convs is on), « Modèle : opus 5.5 », a row per window (minutes or hours back; exact = from the streams themselves, otherwise whole clock hours, Codex whole local days), columns Réponses · Tokens · Temps · TPS pondéré (sum of tokens / sum of time) · Médiane · Plage (min-max); under the pane's width Plage then Temps are left out, numbers are never cut. Then the last `recent` streams « HH:MM:SS  opus 5.5 medium : 59.1 TPS (171 tok en 2.89 s) », green at or above the model's ref_window median. Read from the usage mod's debit.json (re-read only when its mtime changes) and codex.json. aliases: { model id: short name }.

_sections: order: top to bottom, by scope. enabled: which show. open: which foldable sections start unfolded (a closed one shows a one-line summary). breadcrumb = Méga › Projet › Conversation › Agent on one small row; conv = Cette conversation (status line, its tree lead → sub-conversations → Workflows → agents, step, PR/CI; the agent card when an agent is selected); project = Ce projet (its conversations as a tree, factory's Focus and Pipeline); all = Tous les projets (one or two lines per project); conso = Qui consomme (top 3 conversations and the top project of 1 h / aujourd'hui / 7 j, from the usage mod's classement.json; a button opens the full Classement, /conso classement); global = Claude global (quotas, Veille, a /machine button); fichiers = a button that opens filetree's own tab.
_tabs: Tabs of the one pane. home = « Cockpit » (cards + sections, always first); mission, focus, arbre, pipeline, journal = factory's screens (synced copies in lib/factory); workflow = factory's Workflow screen (Gantt, Vitesse; lib/core/gantt.mjs); machine = this PC's load (lib/machine/scanner/machine.py copy) and the runner load (lib/core/runner.mjs). factory's Quotas and Système are not here: the Quota card and Machine replace them. relais = Claude ↔ Codex (the ci mod's ~/.claude/ci-cache/interactions.json: who opened, fixed, merged, hand-offs, dependencies, green rate per agent); galerie = the Reference Gallery views (Équipe: lead → advisor / worker / explorer / researcher lanes and return to lead; Carte: the control layers; Codex: approvals and cost); nuit = « Bilan avant la nuit », opened by the Nuit button of the Cockpit tab (add it to order to get a tab button too).
_menu: The vertical menu at the left of the pane: the band's 6 entries. A press runs the entry's command (a mod cannot open another mod's pane), greyed by a toast when its mod is not loaded; self: true = this pane's Cockpit tab. Under min_columns (the pane's width in columns) it is one row on top. position: left | top | off; width: the menu's columns.
_day_night: The Nuit · Jour · Codex row of the Cockpit tab. Nuit opens « Bilan avant la nuit » (what runs with its end time, unused night hours until nuit.wake, the week quota left and what the night would burn at the current pace, lanes and packets ready to start; then Nuit active = /veille nuit, Lancer = shows the command, never starts anything, Rien = back here). Jour runs /veille jour. repos: extra repo folders read for « Prêt à lancer » besides the folders of the conversations active in the last recent_days.
_nuit: « Bilan avant la nuit » (lib/decide.mjs DECIDE_DEFAULTS.nuit has every default and label): wake = HH:MM; ready_match = what a handoff/ROADMAP.md line must match to be « prêt » (outside the sections matching skip_sections); packet_match = packet file names under packet_dirs; launch / launch_prompt / launch_model / launch_effort = the command « Lancer » shows.
_relais: Claude ↔ Codex tab: max_repos, max_prs shown; labels in lib/decide.mjs DECIDE_DEFAULTS.relais.
_galerie: Galerie tab: views (equipe, lanes, sequence, carte, concept, codex) in order; roles = the agent types of each lane of Équipe (advisor, worker, reviewer = the adversary / reviewer role, explorer, researcher; anything else: Autres); lanes = the selected conversation's project, one lane per worktree active in the last lanes_days days (at most lanes_max), each with its PR and its reviewer agents, or « aucun relecteur » (lane_reviewer_match: a conversation title that makes the lane itself a reviewer lane); sequence = the selected conversation as a sequence diagram (seq_agents lifelines, seq_events latest events); concept = the soft-control map: concept.soft / concept.hard lists of {label, from} where from is a Carte figure (rules, memory, skills, agents, workflows, mods, mode, hooks, env); every label under labels; codex_prices = list price per million tokens by model id prefix (API equivalent, cached input not deducted; unknown model: « tarif inconnu »); codex_days = the window of the Codex view.
_depuis: « Depuis ton dernier message » (button at the top of the Cockpit tab, /cockpit depuis [8h|24h|nuit|HH:MM]): one headline, then one foldable group per project, most important first (waiting on you, CI still red, blocked, failed Workflows, new problems, À toi, merged PRs, finished conversations), with tokens and $ spent. default: the preset used without an argument; presets: last (your last real message in any conversation, skipped when younger than skip_recent_min), hours, at (the most recent HH:MM). red_branches: branches listed red whatever their age (other lanes only when they ran inside the window). gh / glab: merged PRs and MRs (read-only, cached prs_ttl_s). Every label and weight: lib/depuis.mjs DEPUIS_DEFAULTS.
_controle: « Claude Control » card: the open to-dos of file (`- [ ] YYYY-MM-DD · priorité · quoi · …`, « — » = no date), soonest deadline first; warn under warn_days, red under bad_days; max = lines shown.
_cards: Summary cards under the breadcrumb, one line each and a « Voir » button. buttons: per card, the targets tried in order; the first command loaded in this session ($.command.list()) runs, a {tab} target opens one of cockpit's own tabs. Data: scanner/cards.mjs (Node) over lib/core (usage, veille, runner, estimate), the ci mod's pipelines cache and the problemes register (read-only). max_encours: lines of « En cours ». who: claude (default: CI, Quota and En cours count Claude only) or all; the « Codex » button of the Cockpit tab switches for the session. controle = the Claude Control to-dos (settings under `controle`). En cours also lists Agent-tool agents launched outside a Workflow, with their ETA.
_aliases: Old commands kept for habits: after delay_s seconds (other mods register their commands at session start), each name absent from $.command.list() is registered as an alias of /cockpit (/factory [onglet] -> that tab, quotas -> Cockpit, systeme -> Machine; /machine -> Machine). A name that a loaded mod has is left to it.
_machine: Machine tab: seconds between PC samples (only while it shows); gpu_every: one GPU read every N samples.
_default_level: where the selection starts: medium (default: this conversation selected, its Workflows and agents open), macro (its project) or mega.
_auto_open: true: the pane opens by itself when a session starts (also needs userConfig start = on). It sits in the same right column as filetree, as a second tab: the desktop shows one pane at a time, the others as tabs.
_refresh: seconds; nothing is read while the pane is closed or another tab (filetree) is the one shown.
_diagram: the project tree drawn as an SVG under its clickable rows in « Ce projet » (desktop only). Off by default: it repeated the rows.
_qui_consomme: « Qui consomme » card. presets: the toggle (id, label, hours or since: midnight, same shape as usage's classement.presets). top: conversations shown. basis: cost (list-price equivalent) or tokens. rescan_min: when classement.json is older and the section is open, cockpit runs usage's incremental scanner once. data_dir: empty = usage's data_dir. command/args: what the full-view button runs.
_colors: SVG colours (the drawing is an image: theme keys do not reach it). term_colors: theme keys for text.
